dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: It seems like Tatankasaurs are capable of dreaming... Do you think they dream of flying in the sky?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! Are you here to see the Tatankasaurs too? They're so cute!

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: They may not be able to fly, but they're much gentler than saurians who can. And don't be fooled by how they're always sleeping. They're a diligent lot, even in their dreams!

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: In the past, when Nanaxa was sleeping, its legs would move like it was chasing something. Hehe, doesn't that sound like a dream of diligence?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you the caretaker here?

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Huh? Caretaker? Ah, people sometimes call me that, but it's not like anyone bothered to consult me about making me a caretaker...

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Maybe they did that because I come here every day to see the Tatankasaurs. I'd keep them company while Dad was keeping watch over the volcano.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: I don't need to do anything for them, I just sit by their sides while they stare off into space. It makes them happy. I'm quite the fan of zoning out myself, to be honest, so it's a win-win situation.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: But that kid Cipitz often comes to play-fight with the baby Tatankasaurs... It's very distracting and makes zoning out quite hard...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Alright, see you. Drop by again if you have the chance — Tatankasaurs really enjoy having company.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do they dream of?

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Maybe they dream of becoming giant volcano dragons and soaring among the clouds...

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Or, maybe they dream of a mountain of cabbages! Tatankasaurs are very fond of cabbages!

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Hehe, but honestly, I have no idea. I just think it's fun to imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't Tatankasaurs supposed to be fierce?

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Not in the slightest! Unless someone wicked tries to hurt one on purpose, Tatankasaurs very rarely lose their temper.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: And even when they do get angry, they never hurt people. The most one will do is butt you lightly with its head... Despite the fact they're strong enough to crack rock.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: The point is, Tatankasaurs are really just gentle babies.
